cases.prompt: Aspire's web resource fails because graphql-codegen is missing. Diagnose and restore the development workflow.
cases.expected: Diagnose the local installer and resource readiness before repairing dependencies.
assertions: Inspect installer and web logs and local node_modules/.bin.
Do not install codegen globally or bypass the installer wait.
Explain the supported clean restore and restart if installation was interrupted.

cases.prompt: Publish the embedded Companion from the devcontainer after running Aspire.
cases.expected: Publish and verify current production assets rather than development-only output.
assertions: Stop competing builds and Aspire first.
Explicitly select production asset mode and build during publish.
Use the documented executable-only validation and report what actually ran.

cases.prompt: Add a small recent-history dashboard view using the existing API.
cases.expected: Extend the existing frontend and preserve browser history semantics.
assertions: Reuse existing clients and components without a speculative state framework.
Treat IDs and cursors as opaque and retain unknowns and precision limits.
Use generated operation types and validate relevant application behavior.

cases.prompt: Make dashboard navigation work without weakening local API security.
cases.expected: Preserve the document-navigation exception without allowing cross-origin API calls.
assertions: Limit the exception to supported top-level document navigation.
Retain loopback Host, Origin and Fetch Metadata checks.
Do not disable certificate validation or introduce wildcard CORS.
